LanguageData.HH.Dlc.Gizmo.BuyDesc: Buy absolution, mercy or rank for a colonist. Prices follow their ideoligion's stance. The silver comes from colony stock or their pocket.
LanguageData.HH.Dlc.Gizmo.ChooseFaithDesc: Dedicate this altar to an ideoligion. Its followers among your guests will come here to pray.
LanguageData.HH.Dlc.Gizmo.FundDesc: Where your colonists' payments go. The deity keeps them for good; a faction of the same faith warms to you (+1 goodwill per 500 silver, at most +5 per quadrum).
LanguageData.HH.Dlc.Noble.Arrived: A {0} and retinue arrive for {1} days.
LanguageData.HH.Dlc.Noble.BilletText: The Empire orders you to lodge a {0} and {1} retainers for {2} days. They expect a bedroom worthy of their rank ({3}). You will receive about {4} silver for expenses. Refusing costs goodwill and honor.
LanguageData.HH.Dlc.Noble.Left: The noble party leaves. Payment: {0} silver.
LanguageData.HH.Dlc.Noble.OfferText: A {0} with {1} retainers asks to stay for {2} days and will pay about {3} silver if they are comfortable. They expect: {4}. Declining costs nothing.
LanguageData.HH.Dlc.NothingOffered: their faith offers nothing for sale

LanguageData.HH.Setting.dlc.traitSpawn: New traits appear on generated people
LanguageData.HH.Setting.dlc.traitSpawn.Desc: Lucky, Unlucky, Born host and the other Hearth & Harbor traits can show up on newly generated pawns. Existing pawns keep theirs. Off: only added by hand or editor.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.dlc.traitRarity.Desc: Multiplier on how often our traits are rolled for new pawns (1 = same rarity as most vanilla traits).
